steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: A warm up is a period of light exercise that prepares the body for more strenuous activity. It gradually increases heart rate, body temperature and blood flow to working muscles. | Exam Tip: Dynamic stretching is recommended for warm ups. Static stretching is more appropriate for cool downs. Make sure you know the difference. | Definition: A cool down is a period of light exercise after strenuous activity that allows the body to gradually return to its resting state. It helps remove waste products and speeds up recovery. | EPOC (Excess Post-exercise Oxygen Consumption): The elevated oxygen intake after exercise that helps repay the oxygen debt and supports the breakdown of lactic acid. An active cool down supports EPOC more effectively than complete rest.
